splits.title: Crew
splits.intro: Share a fixed part of your future tips or subscriptions with the people who help run your channel. A share comes out of your creator share, after the co-op's part.
splits.payoutNote: Crew are paid like any creator: the treasurer pays them through the manual payout adapter, after the usual hold. Each recipient needs a payout account, and a new recipient's first payout gets a second treasurer's check.
splits.propose.title: Propose a split
splits.propose.hint: Every change is a new version. It applies to revenue after every recipient accepts it, never to money you already received.
splits.propose.done: Split proposed. Each recipient has to accept it.
splits.bpsHint: 100 basis points are 1% of your creator share. Your crew gets {percent} in total; you keep the rest.
splits.startsAtHint: Leave empty to start once everyone accepts.
splits.endsAtHint: Leave empty to run until you end it.
splits.preview.title: What it means
splits.preview.lead: A {example} tip, after the co-op's share, pays:
splits.preview.invalid: Add each recipient and a share between 1 and 9,999 basis points to see what a tip pays.
splits.preview.tooMuch: The crew's shares must leave you something: keep their total under 10,000 basis points.
splits.mine.title: Your channel's splits
splits.mine.hint: Every version, newest first. Ending one stops it for payments after now.
splits.mine.emptyHint: Propose one above to share your revenue with your crew.
splits.offered.title: Splits offered to you
splits.offered.hint: Shares other channels offered you. Nothing is paid to you until you accept.
splits.offered.waiting: {count, plural, one {# split is waiting for your answer.} other {# splits are waiting for your answer.}}
splits.offered.empty: Nobody has offered you a split
splits.offered.emptyHint: When a channel offers you a share of its revenue, it shows up here.
splits.end.title: End version {version}?
splits.end.hint: It stops for payments after now and cannot be backdated. Payments already received keep their split. Your crew is notified.
splits.error.accountAge: A recipient's account is too new. Recipients need an account that has existed for a while.
splits.error.payoutAccount: A recipient has no payout account yet. Ask them to set one up with the treasurer first.
splits.error.ownerIsCrew: You cannot be a recipient of your own channel's split.
splits.error.notFound: We could not find that user or split.
splits.error.conflict: Your splits changed meanwhile, or the shares would add up to more than 100%. Reload and try again.
splits.transparency.title: Split shortfalls and withheld shares
splits.transparency.hint: When a channel owner could not cover a refund of a share they gave their crew, the co-op may write the gap off after a year, with two treasurers' approval. Shares of suspended or terminated recipients are withheld, then released to them or returned to the channel owner.
splits.transparency.writeOffCount: {count, plural, =0 {No write-offs} one {# write-off} other {# write-offs}}
splits.transparency.suspense: Withheld split shares at the latest month end
splits.transparency.suspenseCounts: {released, plural, =0 {None released} one {# release} other {# releases}}, {forfeited, plural, =0 {none returned to owners} one {# returned to an owner} other {# returned to owners}}
